name: Getting to Know Jesus
description: Read the whole Gospel of Mark, the shortest account of Jesus' life, then twelve key chapters from John that show who Jesus said he was.

days.title: The beginning
days.explanation: Jesus is baptized, tested in the wilderness, calls his first disciples, and starts healing people.

days.title: Through the roof
days.explanation: Friends lower a paralyzed man through a roof to reach Jesus, and Jesus forgives his sins before healing him.

days.title: The twelve
days.explanation: Jesus chooses twelve apostles, faces growing opposition, and even his own family struggles to understand him.

days.title: Parables and a storm
days.explanation: The parable of the sower and other stories about God's kingdom, then Jesus calms a storm.

days.title: Three rescues
days.explanation: A man freed from a legion of demons, a woman healed by touching Jesus' cloak, and Jairus's daughter raised.

days.title: Rejection and bread
days.explanation: Jesus is rejected in his hometown, sends out the twelve, feeds five thousand people, and walks on water.

days.title: What makes us unclean
days.explanation: Jesus teaches that what comes out of the heart matters more than outward rules, and he helps a foreign woman who will not give up.

days.title: Who do you say I am?
days.explanation: Peter declares that Jesus is the Christ, and Jesus begins to explain that he must suffer and die.

days.title: On the mountain
days.explanation: Three disciples see Jesus transfigured in glory. Back down the mountain, a father prays, "help thou mine unbelief."

days.title: To serve
days.explanation: Jesus blesses children, challenges a rich man, and says he came not to be served but to serve.

days.title: Into Jerusalem
days.explanation: Jesus rides into Jerusalem to shouts of "Hosanna" and clears the temple.

days.title: Hard questions
days.explanation: Leaders try to trap Jesus with questions. He names the greatest commandment and praises a poor widow's gift.

days.title: Stay awake
days.explanation: Jesus speaks about the destruction of the temple and the end of the age, and tells his followers to watch.

days.title: The last night
days.explanation: The Last Supper, prayer in Gethsemane, the arrest, the trial, and Peter's denial.

days.title: Crucified
days.explanation: Jesus is handed over to Pilate, mocked, crucified, and buried.

days.title: He is risen
days.explanation: The women find the tomb empty and hear that Jesus has risen.

days.title: The Word made flesh
days.explanation: John steps back to eternity: the Word who created all things became a human being and lived among us.

days.title: God so loved the world
days.explanation: Jesus' conversation with Nicodemus about new birth, and the heart of the good news in verse 16.

days.title: The woman at the well
days.explanation: Jesus crosses social lines to offer living water to a Samaritan woman, and her whole town comes to see him.

days.title: Bread of life
days.explanation: The feeding of the five thousand and Jesus' teaching that he himself is the bread that gives life.

days.title: The good shepherd
days.explanation: Jesus calls himself the door and the good shepherd who gives his life for the sheep.

days.title: The resurrection and the life
days.explanation: The raising of Lazarus. Jesus weeps with his friends before showing his power over death.

days.title: The way
days.explanation: On his last night Jesus comforts his disciples: "I am the way, the truth, and the life," and promises the Holy Spirit.

days.title: The vine
days.explanation: Jesus describes himself as the vine and his followers as branches, and calls them friends.

days.title: Jesus prays for us
days.explanation: Jesus prays for his disciples and for everyone who will believe through them.

days.title: It is finished
days.explanation: John's account of the crucifixion, including Jesus caring for his mother from the cross.

days.title: Risen
days.explanation: Mary Magdalene meets the risen Jesus, and doubting Thomas is invited to see for himself.

days.title: Breakfast by the sea
days.explanation: Jesus cooks breakfast for his disciples and gently restores Peter, who had denied him.
